813-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
813-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-3899-8201.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-8201.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1409-7399-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Bogwater Lumaret trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3897-5671.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3897-5671.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and The Necrobloom trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1619-4089.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-4089.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Sakashima the Impostor and Glasspool Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-4089.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

757-2930-4235.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers. Choose not to pay.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on it and skipping your next turn.
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers. Choose not to pay.
Resolve the Portent Tracker ability, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

240-955-5147-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

147-4668-7300.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least 2 cards this turn.
147-4668-7300.description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost reduced by Heliod, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost reduced by Heliod
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Dualcaster Mage.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage from exile by paying {0} due to Heliod
Repeat from step 3.

296-341-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-341-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

372-3306-6991.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3306-6991.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Donnie & April and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Donnie & April trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2511-6054-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-2324-2448-5220.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2324-2448-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4067-4823-5527-6281.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
4067-4823-5527-6281.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Timeless Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Timeless Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.

224-225-1772-3478.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
224-225-1772-3478.notes: You can untap any land using Stone-Seeder Hierophant's ability if you wish to gain other color(s) and/or type(s) of mana, or use other abilities once you have infinite mana.

1770-2608-4605.notablePrerequisites: You control up to six permanents that can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{W}{U}.
1770-2608-4605.description:
Activate up to six permanents by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it and Preston trigger twice.
Resolve both Derevi triggers, untapping up to two permanents.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Derevi that is a 0/1 Illusion creature token.
Put the nontoken Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule, and choose to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When the Derevi token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, untapping up to two permanents.
Resolve the second Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Derevi that is a 0/1 Illusion creature token.
Put either Derevi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Derevi token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, untapping up to two permanents.
Activate up to six permanents by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Put the remaining Derevi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

1069-1256-2079-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1256-2079-5499.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

3129-4559-4740-5670.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 10.
3129-4559-4740-5670.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasures, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinitely to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1849-3259-5251.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-5251.description:
Declare Emmara and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token with lifelink.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Soldier token, untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1294-2167-3909-4423-4426.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Islands and one basic Forest.
1294-2167-3909-4423-4426.description:
Activate a Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Summer Bloom by paying {1}{G}, allowing you to play three more lands this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or from your graveyard.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, putting Summer Bloom on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Nurturing Peatland by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Summer Bloom from the top of your library.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and a Forest, adding {G}{U}.
Play the Forest and Nurturing Peatland from your graveyard.
Repeat.

313-1387-2948-5296.description:
Remove 4 counters from Workhorse to produce {4}.
pay {1} to Initiates of the Ebon Hand to produce {B}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback to return Workhorse from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
